inputs.content: What's the TDP of the Ryzen 7 7800X3D, the launch price of the Core i7-13700K, and the sensor size of the Sony A7R V?
The Ryzen 7 7800X3D has a 120 W TDP. The Core i7-13700K launched at $409. The Sony A7R V uses a 61.0 MP full-frame (35.7 × 23.8 mm) CMOS sensor.
What's the TDP of the Ryzen 9 7950X, the launch price of the Core i9-13900K, and the sensor size of the Nikon Z9?
The Ryzen 9 7950X has a 170 W TDP. The Nikon Z9 uses a 45.7 MP stacked full-frame (35.9 × 23.9 mm) CMOS sensor.
Tell me the ISA extension for Apple's M2 Max, the TDP for Snapdragon 8 Gen 2, and the launch price for Google Tensor G2.

Apple's M2 Max implements ARMv8.6-A with proprietary extensions. The Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 has a ~5.5 W typical TDP in phone configs. The Google Tensor G2 debuted in the Pixel 7 series at $599/$899 phone pricing — no standalone SoC price published.
Tell me the ISA extension for MediaTek Dimensity 9200, the TDP for Apple A16 Bionic, and the launch price for Samsung Exynos 2200.
The Dimensity 9200 implements ARMv9-A with SVE2. The Exynos 2200 was never sold standalone; it shipped in the Galaxy S22 series priced from $799.
What's the sensor size of the Canon R5, the launch price of the Fuji X-H2S, and the TDP of the RTX 4090?
The Canon EOS R5 has a 45 MP full-frame (36 × 24 mm) CMOS sensor. The Fujifilm X-H2S launched at $2,499 body-only. The GeForce RTX 4090 has a 450 W TDP.
What's the sensor size of the Sony A1, the launch price of the Nikon Z8, and the TDP of the RX 7900 XTX?
The Sony A1 uses a 50.1 MP full-frame (35.9 × 24.0 mm) stacked CMOS. The Radeon RX 7900 XTX has a 355 W TDP.
ISA extension for Ryzen 7000 series, TDP for Core Ultra 7 155H, launch price for Arc A770 16GB.

Ryzen 7000 supports AVX-512 via AVX-512F, CD, BW, DQ, VL, IFMA, VBMI, BF16, VPOPCNTDQ, BITALG, VNNI, VP2INTERSECT. The Core Ultra 7 155H has a 28 W base / 115 W max turbo TDP. The Intel Arc A770 16GB launched at $349.
ISA extension for EPYC 9004 series, TDP for Xeon Platinum 8490H, launch price for Instinct MI300X.
EPYC 9004 (Genoa) supports AVX-512 including VNNI, BF16, VP2INTERSECT. The Instinct MI300X launched at ~$15,000–$20,000 estimated.
Sensor size of GFX 100 II, launch price of Hasselblad X2D 100C, TDP of M2 Ultra.
The Fujifilm GFX 100 II uses a 102 MP medium-format (43.8 × 32.9 mm) sensor. The Hasselblad X2D 100C launched at $8,199. The Apple M2 Ultra has a ~60 W sustained TDP in Mac Studio.
Sensor size of Phase One IQ4 150MP, launch price of Leica M11, TDP of Snapdragon 8cx Gen 3.
The Phase One IQ4 150MP uses a 151 MP medium-format (53.4 × 40.0 mm) CMOS. The Snapdragon 8cx Gen 3 has a ~9 W TDP in laptop designs.

Blenheim Palace in Oxfordshire was designed by Sir John Vanbrugh and Nicholas Hawksmoor for the 1st Duke of Marlborough; construction ran from 1705 to 1722 and the palace became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1987. Who was the architect, when was it completed, what is its current use, and what heritage grade does it hold?

The principal architects were Sir John Vanbrugh and Nicholas Hawksmoor; the palace was completed in 1722; today it serves as the private residence of the Dukes of Marlborough and is also open to the public as a historic house and events venue; it holds Grade I listed status and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Name the architect, the completion date, the current use, and its listed grade.

The main architects were William Talman and Thomas Archer; the rebuilding was completed in 1706; the house remains the private family seat of the Duke of Devonshire and operates as a visitor attraction with gardens, farmyard and events; it is designated Grade I on the National Heritage List for England.

Highclere Castle in Hampshire was originally a medieval palace of the Bishops of Winchester before Sir Charles Barry remodelled it in Jacobethan style between 1842 and 1849 for the 3rd Earl of Carnarvon; the 5th Earl funded Howard Carter's discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb. Who was the remodel architect, when was the remodelling finished, who owns it now, and what is its heritage grade?

The remodelling architect was Sir Charles Barry; work finished in 1849; the castle is still owned by the Earl of Carnarvon and functions as a private home, wedding venue and film location (notably Downton Abbey); it holds Grade I listed building status.

Hampton Court Palace on the Thames began as a manor acquired by Thomas Wolsey around 1514, then vastly expanded by Henry VIII from 1529; Christopher Wren later added the Baroque Fountain Court for William III and Mary II in the 1690s. Identify the original builder, the date of Henry VIII's expansion, the current managing body, and its listed grade.
The original builder was Cardinal Thomas Wolsey; Henry VIII's expansion began in 1529; the palace is managed by Historic Royal Palaces, an independent charity; the entire complex is Grade I listed.

Kedleston Hall in Derbyshire was designed by Robert Adam for the Curzon family between 1759 and 1765, replacing an earlier house; its Marble Hall with Corinthian columns and the State Drawing Room are considered among Adam's finest interiors. Who was the architect, when was it completed, how is it used today, and what heritage listing does it carry?

The architect was Robert Adam; completion came in 1765; the hall is now owned by the National Trust and operates as a historic house museum with events and holiday lets; it holds Grade I listed status.
